oneOf.description: The receipt of a job run.

command.description: The command this receipt describes: always `engrave` — `cut` is the same command, and the receipt does not change with its spelling.

anyOf.description: The coupon sweep summary, when the run was a coupon.

parameter.description: The case parameter the sweep varies.

recordFile.description: The coupon record file name the run wrote.

rowCount.description: Program rows the record carries to fill in.

values.description: The values swept, in the spec’s order.

coupon.description: The coupon summary, or null for a job or design run.

kind.description: Which input built the run: a job, a 3MF design, or a coupon spec.

outDir.description: The directory the files were written into.

anyOf.description: The two-program summary, when a rest pass ran.

leftoverAreaMm2.description: Design area still standing between the two programs, mm².

restDiameterMm.description: The second cutter’s cutting diameter, mm.

restRemovedVolumeMm3.description: Material the second program removed on its own, mm³.

roughDiameterMm.description: The first cutter’s cutting diameter, mm.

thirdToolShare.description: The leftover as a share of what the design asks for, or null.

thirdToolSuggested.description: Whether a third cutter is suggested, or null when not judged.

thirdToolThreshold.description: The shop’s third-cutter threshold, as a fraction, or null.

pair.description: The two-program summary, or null when only one program ran.

programs.description: Every program the run wrote, in the order written.

items.description: One program a run wrote.

anyOf.description: The CAM summary for one program.

baselineRapidMm.description: Rapid travel the pre-#487 ordering would have spent, mm, or null.

cutMm.description: Cutting travel, mm, or null when not recorded.

rapidMm.description: Rapid (air) travel, mm, or null when not recorded.

cam.description: The CAM summary, or null when the CAM produced none.

frameFile.description: The frame `.nc` file name, or null when none was written.

images.description: Preview PNG file names rendered for this program.

name.description: The job name the program was written under.

ncFile.description: The `.nc` file name, without its directory.

ok.description: Whether the generator itself reported success.

previews.description: Preview SVG file names written for this program.

estimatedTime.description: The estimated time the sheet prints.

file.description: The run sheet file name, without its directory.

ncHash.description: The hash of the `.nc` the sheet describes.

sheet.description: The run sheet written for this program, or null when none was.

anyOf.description: The simulation summary for one program.

engine.description: The sweep engine that ran, e.g. `exact` or `raster`.

removedVolumeMm3.description: Material the sweep removed, mm³, when the mesh is present.

stage.description: The pipeline stage the program reached, e.g. `done`.
